patch_description: The proposed ansatz architecture uses a dual-entanglement strategy within each block to maximize qubit interaction while maintaining high parameter efficiency. It combines a local CNOT ring (nearest-neighbor) and a global CNOT cross (long-range: i, i+4) to ensure rapid information spread across the 8-qubit register. This structure is sandwiched between two layers of single-qubit rotations (RY and RZ) that use even/odd parameter sharing to constrain the total parameter count (38 circuit parameters total). The use of CNOTs instead of CZs, in conjunction with the RZ/RY layers, improves the non-commutativity with the fixed IsingZZ feature map, enhancing the circuit's expressivity and reducing the generalization gap observed in previous iterations.
